title: Annotate SwitchConnectionTool connectionString as a secret
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/tools/mongodb/connect/switchConnection.ts (argsShape.connectionString, lines 13-20 at pinnedCommit aaa72a04), add isSecret: true metadata to the zod schema. Keep .optional() and the existing .describe() text. Use the ConfigFieldMeta key defined in src/common/config/configUtils.ts:33, which userConfig.ts:40-46 already applies to the config-level connectionString. Attach it with a zod registry or .meta() so the field is secret-marked in the tool inputSchema that tool.ts register() publishes (line 717). If the connect tool finding is fixed at the same time, use the same mechanism for both. Constraints: open a PR against main that needs 1 approval (sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess.approvalsRequired). Do not change the argument name, optionality or description, because that would change the public tool contract.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -n isSecret src/tools/mongodb/connect/switchConnection.ts` in the checkout returns a match inside argsShape.connectionString
`pnpm run check:types` and `pnpm run build` exit 0 on the PR branch
The inputSchema that the MCP server returns from tools/list for switch-connection shows connectionString with the secret metadata, while its type (optional string) and description are unchanged

verificationMethod.description: A reviewer opens the PR diff for src/tools/mongodb/connect/switchConnection.ts. Expected result: connectionString carries isSecret: true metadata through the same key as userConfig.ts:40-46, and argsShape has no other change. The reviewer also confirms that the CI checks (check:types, build) are green.

rootCause.description: When switch-connection was added, its argsShape did not copy the isSecret metadata that the config-level connectionString has. The tool argument is therefore the one path where a credential-bearing URI enters the server with no secret marking.
